title: Answer: information in the algorithmic sense is what an observer is

statements.text: Information is meant in the sense of algorithmic information theory. A self state is an abstract pattern, formalized as a finite binary string, and the chance of each next state is fixed by algorithmic probability, which weights continuations by the length of the programs that produce them. An information-theoretic observer comes before matter.

sources.quote: Self states are simply abstract patterns (perhaps formalized as finite binary strings or natural numbers)
an information-theoretic notion of observer (“mind”) could in some sense be more fundamental
